name: MipChainOptions
signature: public readonly record struct MipChainOptions(bool Srgb, bool NormalMap = false, float? CoverageCutoff = null)

params.Srgb: Colour averaged as light rather than as stored values.
params.NormalMap: Texels are tangent space normals, renormalized after averaging.
params.CoverageCutoff: Alpha test threshold whose coverage every level keeps, null to leave alpha alone.
